recommendations.title: Keep original local evidence and the existing review model
recommendations.problem: Feature expansion could erase useful context or replace a functioning personal workflow.
recommendations.user_task: Review deliberate narrated walkthroughs and keep original pixels, speech, notes and code clues reachable.
recommendations.proposal: Keep the Swift/Python/plain-JavaScript stack, session-bounded capture, raw local files, review marks, source links and --local PGM handoff. Treat edited output and future summaries as derivatives, not replacements.
recommendations.benefit: Retains the project’s useful combination without claiming market uniqueness.
recommendations.cost: Low; guard invariants and resist unrelated scope.
recommendations.alternative: O1: current app plus manual Markdown/Finder workflow.

confidence.level: high for existing capability; medium for product fit
confidence.basis: Static source verifies mechanisms; Byron’s primary goal remains provisional.

proof.measure: Hash raw MP4, activity/browser logs, pages and cached raw transcript; compare captured-mark fields before/after review/export. Allow only intentionally added review marks and explicitly edited note fields in marks.jsonl.
proof.acceptance: No unintended raw mutation; existing review remains usable when optional derived output is absent.

recommendations.failure_rule: Reject a proposed addition that destroys source evidence or requires a new service before showing task value.

recommendations.title: Make collection and export scope truthful
recommendations.problem: Input-value exclusion is contradicted by code; selected exports may include full transcript and full frames.
recommendations.user_task: Capture locally and hand off only explicitly chosen content without a false safety claim.
recommendations.proposal: Correct categorical privacy wording; remove value-derived structured input text; preview outgoing transcript/image/page scope. Keep private originals and clearly labeled selected derivatives. Evaluate the minimal intended localhost peer policy, not enterprise security infrastructure.
recommendations.benefit: Reduces unexpected data collection and makes selection meaningful without silently deleting evidence.
recommendations.cost: Small for wording/field exclusion; medium for per-artifact export scope. Full automatic redaction remains excluded.
recommendations.alternative: Keep artifacts local/private, avoid sharing raw sessions and manually inspect copied findings.

confidence.level: high for mismatch; medium for proposed controls
confidence.basis: Reachable source paths are explicit; full sanitized export is unproved.

proof.measure: Canaries across input, props, selection, URLs, network body, MHTML and pixels; selected-two-of-five export.
proof.acceptance: No prohibited canary in the claimed selected derivative; all inclusion decisions visible; benign source clue preserved.

recommendations.failure_rule: Do not call output sanitized if any included surface lacks a tested exclusion contract. Fall back to local-private-only rather than broad automatic redaction.

recommendations.title: Preserve notes, provenance and sentence semantics across outputs
recommendations.problem: Portable HTML omits typed findings/review labels and uses a different sentence-selection rule.
recommendations.user_task: Reopen or copy a reviewed finding without losing its conclusion or source meaning.
recommendations.proposal: Define a small shared semantic fixture for native Markdown, processor Markdown and portable viewer read/copy. Preserve note-first title, note body, review provenance and exact sentence-start behavior. Do not introduce a general rendering framework.
recommendations.benefit: Repairs an actual handoff path before adding another view.
recommendations.cost: Small-to-medium; focused synchronization across existing Swift/Python/JavaScript seams.
recommendations.alternative: Use native Copy as Markdown and processor session.md; explicitly warn that the current HTML view is incomplete for notes.

confidence.basis: Direct source comparison identifies the divergent fields and sentence rules.

proof.measure: Golden fixture includes note, source=review, crop/full frame, adjacent short sentences and a silence gap.
proof.acceptance: 100% of required semantic fields preserved; selected sentence matches expected source start in both views.

recommendations.failure_rule: Reject any new surface that drops the review conclusion or invents live DOM evidence. Keep current native review while fixing parity.

recommendations.title: Expose processing outcomes and bounded retry
recommendations.problem: Failed/unavailable transcription can appear silent, and initial processing ignores exit status.
recommendations.user_task: Know what is ready after capture and recover a derived output without recapturing.
recommendations.proposal: Use a compact stage/result state and a local retry path. Distinguish no audio, not requested, pending, unavailable, failed and ready. Reuse Review.reprocess behavior and existing logs where practical; preserve raw files.
recommendations.benefit: Separates capture success from searchable transcript success and avoids misleading completion.
recommendations.cost: Small-to-medium. Interrupted-media recovery is a separate risk, not solved by this change.
recommendations.alternative: Manual processor re-run with visible process.log; document unavailable dependencies rather than pretending silence.

confidence.level: high for state mismatch; medium for UX benefit
confidence.basis: Static initial/review control-flow differs; frequency is not measured.

proof.measure: No-audio, cached-transcript, missing executable, nonzero subprocess and malformed-output fixtures.
proof.acceptance: Every outcome correctly labeled; retry produces no duplicate findings or unintended raw mutation.

recommendations.failure_rule: Reject a service/queue abstraction unless a demonstrated multi-job need defeats one explicit local processing action.

recommendations.title: Prove the find–select–handoff local review task
recommendations.problem: Current chronological navigation has no app-level text query; useful findings may still require manual scanning and packaging.
recommendations.user_task: Find a remembered phrase/error, inspect its mark/source, write a conclusion and hand off selected evidence.
recommendations.proposal: First benchmark O1 with existing mark navigation and Markdown. Then propose only in-session lexical search with match context/time plus faithful selected handoff. Keep one player and existing notes; no vector database or cloud search.
recommendations.benefit: Targets the entire personal review task rather than isolated feature parity.
recommendations.cost: Small for one-session search; medium for portable selection. Cross-session indexing deferred.
recommendations.alternative: Search generated Markdown in an existing editor or browser and use native marks/Copy.

confidence.basis: Missing query is verified; actual time saved is not measured.

proof.measure: Six paired retrieval-to-handoff tasks over three matched synthetic sessions; rotate task/view order and count correction/packaging time.
proof.acceptance: No accuracy loss; median completion time at least 20% lower and at least four of six pairs faster than the stronger no-build baseline; raw provenance intact.

recommendations.failure_rule: If gains are below the predeclared target or correction overhead removes them, keep O1/O2 and do not build cross-session search or a new review surface.

recommendations.title: Qualify temporal and browser-source evidence
recommendations.problem: Intent time, screenshot exposure, DOM request and event receipt can differ; connectivity and tab/source precision may be overstated.
recommendations.user_task: Interpret what evidence really supports a finding and open the likely source without false precision.
recommendations.proposal: Expose existing source-kind/precision distinctions first. Preserve occurrence/receipt identity where useful, label stale/unknown context, and validate the existing Solid source-attribute path. Add exact media provenance only when clipping/canvas or a measured mismatch requires it.
recommendations.benefit: Maintains trust while keeping a small data model.
recommendations.cost: Small for labels and one source fixture; medium for additional capture clocks/session metadata.
recommendations.alternative: Treat all context as approximate and manually verify the original interval/source file.

confidence.level: high for differing clocks; medium for prioritization
confidence.basis: Source shows distinct asynchronous paths; user-facing error frequency is unknown.

proof.measure: Delayed-region counter, stale reconnect/two-tab trace and exact/transformed/missing-file source cases.
proof.acceptance: No false same-instant, wrong-tab or exact-line assertion; usable fallback when provenance is unavailable.

recommendations.failure_rule: Do not add a generalized clock service or framework adapter layer when explicit labels and bounded capture/session rules solve the observed task.

recommendations.title: Reuse speech, annotation and polished-video specialists
recommendations.problem: General dictation, mature image editing and video polish are distinct products with substantial maintenance demands.
recommendations.user_task: Dictate a review note, annotate a crop or publish a polished explanation.
recommendations.proposal: Try a single appropriate specialist manually with existing local artifacts. Keep dictated notes separate from original narration and annotated/edited derivatives separate from source. Select local versus cloud processing deliberately.
recommendations.benefit: Tests unmet workflows without replacing the stack or copying low-value parity features.
recommendations.cost: Low implementation cost; possible license, permission, setup and application-switching cost.
recommendations.alternative: Use typed notes, native crops and unedited MP4 only.

confidence.level: high for available alternatives; medium for personal fit
confidence.basis: Current primary sources verify the workflows; no local side-by-side use was performed.

proof.measure: One note-writing, one two-location image explanation and one polished-demo task using a specialist versus current tools.
proof.acceptance: Task-specific gain after correction/round-trip effort, with original evidence preserved and intended data boundary respected.

recommendations.failure_rule: Do not build an integration when the task is rare or a manual copy/open/export is sufficient.

recommendations.title: Keep a source-linked board/canvas as a conditional alternative
recommendations.problem: Serial video can be a poor reading/comparison surface, but the existing spatial proposal is unproved.
recommendations.user_task: Read long scrolled content and compare changed states while returning to actual source moments.
recommendations.proposal: Preserve prior intent without overwriting it. Compare a useful change-selected board with existing review; only then run the bounded one-viewport automatic scroll/edit/refused-join proof. Use the existing HTML player/JSON seam first; native canvas comes later only if earned.
recommendations.benefit: Tests a meaningfully different workflow without assuming geometry is the winner.
recommendations.cost: Medium-to-large; source mapping, false joins, image budgets and export meaning dominate.
recommendations.alternative: Chronological marks or a simple contact sheet/storyboard linked to original video.

confidence.basis: Prior proposal is coherent, but there is no implemented or measured canvas in this baseline.

proof.measure: One viewport, three-height scroll, visible edit and unsupported jump; compare video, useful board and canvas with all setup/correction time included.
proof.acceptance: Every displayed patch maps to a real frame/crop; no harmful accepted join or lost required change; clear incremental value over the stronger simple view.

recommendations.failure_rule: Prefer the simpler board if geometry adds no task value. Refuse uncertain joins; do not render unobserved content or claim general-video support.

recommendations.title: Add capture breadth only for a recurring blocked task
recommendations.problem: Main-display-only recording and disabled system audio can miss some real workflows, but broad parity adds risk.
recommendations.user_task: Capture another display/window or an application sound that is necessary to explain the issue.
recommendations.proposal: Use a specialist capture as a counterfactual. If the task is recurring, propose one target or audio capability and validate coordinates/timing/permissions; retain existing defaults. Leave webcam, cinematic effects and blanket 4K/60 below the cut line.
recommendations.benefit: Removes a demonstrated blocker instead of optimizing a speculative spec sheet.
recommendations.cost: Medium; target geometry, permission handling, audio routing and pause-time mapping are coupled.
recommendations.alternative: Move the relevant window to the main display or use OBS/CleanShot for that recording.

confidence.level: high for current limits; low-to-medium for demand
confidence.basis: Recorder configuration is explicit; no supplied user recording demonstrates the blocked task.

proof.measure: Authorized synthetic cross-display or app-audio case; verify intended content and aligned marks with no new privacy surprise.
proof.acceptance: Current workflow demonstrably blocked, specialist baseline succeeds, proposed single capability restores completion without source/time regression.

recommendations.failure_rule: Reject a bundled capture rewrite when a simpler operating habit or external recorder is adequate.

recommendations.title: Decline cloud-team, always-on and full editor expansion by default
recommendations.problem: Competitor breadth can pull a personal review tool into several unrelated infrastructure-heavy products.
recommendations.user_task: Maintain a dependable single-developer local workflow.
recommendations.proposal: Do not add a hosted workspace, team accounts, autonomous issue creation, mandatory DOM/execution replay, a systemwide dictation engine or a full video studio in the first direction. Keep deliberate manual/structured handoff and specialist escalation.
recommendations.benefit: Protects maintenance budget and source fidelity; avoids implementing features simply because they are common in another category.
recommendations.cost: Opportunity cost if the true goal later changes; alternatives remain available.
recommendations.alternative: O4, O5 or O7 as explicit new product-boundary decisions after evidence, primarily by reuse.

confidence.basis: No team/commercial requirement is supplied; existing competitors already serve the broader tasks.

proof.measure: For each requested expansion, state one recurring task, why O1/O2 fails, and why an existing tool cannot satisfy the boundary.
proof.acceptance: A concrete unmet need is demonstrated before a separate proposal is considered.

recommendations.failure_rule: A competitor checkbox or unverified uniqueness claim is insufficient. Keep the omission when no task-level case exists.

human_decisions.question: Which primary outcome should govern the next proof: personal bug/product review, polished communication, or general dictation?
human_decisions.default: Personal local review is provisional, not a discovered preference.
human_decisions.consequence: Review selects O3/RT-05; communication selects O5 specialist reuse; dictation selects O2/RT-07. Do not approve a broad implementation before this choice.

human_decisions.question: What data may leave the private session folder, and who must consume it?
human_decisions.default: Local private originals; explicit selected, previewed derivatives; no automatic upload.
human_decisions.consequence: Determines export scope and whether a hosted specialist is acceptable. A raw full-session handoff requires a deliberate broader choice.

human_decisions.question: How much measured benefit must a new local-review surface deliver to justify its maintenance cost?
human_decisions.default: Keep the simpler workflow unless it clears a predeclared provisional 20% full-task time gain with no accuracy loss.
human_decisions.consequence: Set the acceptance budget before evaluation, for lexical retrieval or a separately justified spatial-reading alternative. Do not move the threshold afterward or expand scope merely because a prototype exists.
